messages:
alex: Heads-up — GPU crates scheduled to land at the colo tomorrow 04:00 UTC. I want a quick scan of anything that could block unpack/slot-in so we can avoid a midnight fire drill.

maria: Power clearance still pending from colo ops. I pinged their on-call (ticket #COLO-482) earlier, waiting for the tech sign-off. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: @maria can you paste the expected rack PDU configuration once it's confirmed? need to validate breakers before we ship teams out.

maria: Will do. Current ask is 2x 32A feeds per rack, single-phase for site. If they change to 3-phase we need to replan cable drops.


tanvi: Heads up on firmware — vendor says the HBA firmware on the new nodes is at an older rev that breaks nvlink on our test images. Need to run vendor updater before bringing into the cluster. ETA for flash script is 30m if we have console access.

jordan: I put a short patch window on the on-call calendar 03:30-05:00 UTC in case we need firmware + bios updates once crates are in. If power sign-off slips we can push to the daytime crew but prefer to do it overnight.

samir: Networking question: do we have IPs reserved for these racks? I think the /29 for the new POD is in the spreadsheet but not yet assigned in Terraform. If we don't assign, we can't provision management NAT.

elaine: I updated the infra spreadsheet — IP block 10.240.91.0/29 reserved but not yet in TF. @samir can you add the allocation to the `mgmt-nets` TF var? small snippet: ```hcl resource "aws_vpc_ipam_pool_cidr" "pod_mgmt" { cidr = "10.240.91.0/29" }```

samir: On it. I'll open a PR now and tag @alex for review.

maria: Logistics check — do we have a fallback if the colo can't staff unload? We can arrange the vendor to deliver to a staging bay but that adds a 2h delay.

alex: Good point. Plan A = colo unload and our crew. Plan B = vendor staging -> we do remote firmware + preflight remotely and schedule in-person slot later. Plan C = postpone to daytime delivery.

logistics-bot: Delivery ETA update: crate #A7 now expected at 04:07 UTC (carrier code: XFR-992). Contact: ben@vendor.example.com.

tanvi: Quick preflight checklist I want run as soon as nodes power on: 1) IPMI reachable 2) iLO/idrac firmware rev check 3) nvlink self-test 4) nvme health 5) dmesg for PCI errors. Minimal commands: ```ssh ops@10.240.91.10 'ipmitool lan print' && ssh ops@10.240.91.10 'sudo nvme list' && ssh ops@10.240.91.10 'dmesg | grep -i pci'```

jordan: I'll have an ops pair on-call overnight to run those. @tanvi can you drop the exact expected firmware revs in the thread so they don't accidentally skip a step?

tanvi: Expected fw: HBA 3.4.1, iDRAC 2.7.8. If we see HBA <3.3.0 we need to flash vendor image.

alex: PR for TF by @samir please include a short rollback plan in commit message (how to unassign the /29). If colo sign-off comes in now we should be green.

samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 — includes mgmt-net var + rollback notes. tagging @alex @elaine for quick review.

maria: Colo ops just replied — power crew confirmed, they’ll be onsite at 03:45 UTC for feed verification.

alex: Awesome. Two final asks: (1) @jordan confirm ops pair that will be onsite/remote, (2) if anything changes post-unpack, post updates here so we can coordinate canary scheduling.

jordan: Ops pair is me + tuesday-oncall (samir backing remote). I'll post a status update in this thread at 04:15 and again after preflight.

samir: Will monitor PR and be on standby for any TF rollback. Good luck team — try to get some sleep before the 3am run. :zzz:
